content:
If you missed yesterday's 'Surprise and Shine' event and don't want to watch the full hour-plus long video, Apple's YouTube channel has you covered. Check out the recap below.

Apple releases brief event recap video

In addition to the iPhone Duo and Apple's first foldable iPhone, Apple also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, along with the Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4, and AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

The event ran for approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes, featuring Apple's signature style throughout — executives speaking to the camera, interspersed with marketing demonstrations and product ads.

If you're short on time, Apple also released a rather entertaining brief recap video featuring a narrator bouncing around to summarize the highlights of each announcement segment.

Apple has also uploaded the full presentation segments for each product individually, which you can watch below.
